description: Run MoE models bigger than your RAM. Frontier-size MoE on a phone, laptop, edge. Lossless, on stock llama.cpp. An adaptive streaming optimizer. Any hardware, any OS, any model, any quantization, behind a local OpenAI-compatible server.

latest_release.name: v0.46.1
latest_release.body:
### Fixed
- **Qwen3.6-35B-A3B downloads from the catalog again** (since 2026-11-08, on every release, #663, #665).
  The catalog named its file on the repository's `main` branch, where a new conversion was uploaded
  (20,542,732,576 bytes instead of 20,419,565,568, another SHA-256), so every download was refused
  at the end: "downloaded size does not match the catalog". Every catalog file is now named at the
  commit its size and SHA-256 were taken from (`resolve/<commit>/`), each checked against the
  repository, and `bmoe_server_test` fails a row that names a branch or carries no SHA-256. Qwen3.6
  stays the file the published numbers were measured on ([field-reports.md](docs/field-reports.md)).

detail.readme:
English · 中文 · 日本語 · Español · Français · Italiano

Run Mixture-of-Experts models larger than your device's memory. The experts are read from flash as the model needs them. Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux, built on llama.cpp. Unified Streaming Framework - from phones, laptops, consumer and data-center GPUs - Supports any hardware, any OS, any model, any quant. Automated resource scheduling tailor made to optimize tok/s.
12 GB Android phone
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · 5-6 tok/s		 12 GB iPhone
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · 6 tok/s
16 GB Apple-silicon laptop
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · 18-24 tok/s
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, larger than each device's memory; any MoE model in GGUF runs, at any quantization. Decode speeds are the [Performance](#performance) table's. **The agent on a 2021 laptop, no GPU**: the viral voxel-pagoda prompt to the built-in agent on a ThinkPad with 16 GB of RAM, CPU only, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M. 988 lines at 2.3 tok/s, then the page in the app's preview; the speed-ups are marked on screen.

## What it does - **Runs models that do not fit.** A MoE model uses a few experts per token. The engine keeps the weights every token needs and the experts used most in memory, and reads the rest from flash. The output is the same as with the whole model in memory; the tests check it. - **Sets itself up.** `--auto` measures the machine and the model and picks the cache size, the threads and which device does what. The Plan screen shows each choice and why. - **Any MoE GGUF.** Whatever llama.cpp loads, in any quantization. No per-model code. - **Every backend.** CPU, Metal, CUDA, HIP, Vulkan, OpenCL and the Hexagon NPU. On a graphics card, the experts used most stay in its VRAM. - **Apps and a server.** A desktop app, phone apps, and an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible server for coding agents. - **Sees images.** Put a model's projector file (`mmproj`) beside it and the server reads images on every API; the CLI with `--mmproj` and `--image`. Any vision model llama.cpp's projector library knows, any quantization, every backend. ## Performance | Hardware | Memory | Model | On disk | Experts from | Decode tok/s | |---|---|---|---:|---|---:| | **Android phone** | 12 GB | DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B | 91 GB | flash | 1 | | | | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 80 GB | flash | 2-4 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | flash | 5-6 | | **iPhone** | 12 GB | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | flash | 6 | | **Apple-silicon laptop** | 16 GB | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 76 GB | flash | 7-9 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | flash | 18-24 | | **Windows laptop** | 16 GB | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | flash | 5 | | **Desktop GPU** (NVIDIA) | 12 GB + 128 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 84 GB | RAM, GPU cache | 16-17 | | **Desktop GPU** (NVIDIA) | 16 GB + 32 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | flash, GPU cache | 19-21 | | **Desktop GPU** (NVIDIA) | 24 GB + 96 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | RAM, GPU cache | 70 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | GPU | 217 | | **Desktop GPU** (NVIDIA) | 24 GB + 62 GB RAM | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | GPU | 154 | | | 12 GB of it free | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | RAM, GPU cache | 59-67 | | | | Gemma 4 26B-A4B | 17 GB | GPU | 114 | | | | Laguna XS 2.1 33B | 20 GB | GPU | 93-94 | | **Desktop GPU** (NVIDIA) | 8 GB + 31 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | flash, GPU cache | 16 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | RAM, GPU cache | 37-44 | | **Two desktop GPUs** (NVIDIA) | 2 × 16 GB + 60 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | RAM, GPU cache | 41-48 | | | | DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B | 91 GB | flash, GPU cache | 5 | | **Datacenter GPU** (AMD, ROCm) | 192 GB | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | GPU | 53 | A range is the spread across runs. Method and every run: [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md). To add your machine, run `scripts/bench-report.sh model.gguf` and open a [benchmark report](https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/issues/new?template=benchmark-report.yml). ## Install From the [latest release](https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/releases/latest): - **macOS** (Apple silicon): open the `.dmg` and drag the app to Applications. It is not notarised yet; the dmg's README.txt has the one step for the first start. - **Windows**: run the `-setup.exe`. No administrator rights. - **Linux**: make the `.AppImage` executable and run it. The window needs WebKitGTK 4.1; `--server` runs the server alone. - **Android**: install `app-dev-release.apk`. Each release installs over the previous one. - **iOS**: build it with Xcode from [examples/ios](examples/ios/README.md). Experimental. Open the app and pick a model under **Models**. An NVIDIA or AMD card gets its backend from **Settings** ([docs/desktop-app.md](docs/desktop-app.md)). Command-line tools only (`bmoe-cli`, `bmoe-server`): ```bash curl -fsSL https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh ``` ```powershell irm https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` ## Use ```bash bmoe-cli -m model.gguf --auto -p "Explain MoE routing." # plan and run bmoe-cli -m model.gguf --plan # print the plan bmoe-server -m model.gguf -c 32768 # the server and its web UI, port 8765 ``` The server speaks the OpenAI API (`/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`) and the Anthropic one (`/v1/messages`), with streaming, tool calls and reasoning. Add `--host 0.0.0.0 --api-key KEY` to serve other machines. Reference: [docs/server-api.md](docs/server-api.md). On a machine that stays on, register it as a service of your login instead: it starts with the machine, comes back with its model, and reloads it when a request finds none loaded ([running as a service](docs/server-api.md#running-as-a-service)). ```bash bmoe-server service install --host 0.0.0.0 -m model.gguf -c 65536 # systemd, launchd or Task Scheduler bmoe-server service status ``` ```python from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1", api_key="local") reply = client.chat.completions.create(model="local", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]) print(reply.choices[0].message.content) ``` **Coding agents** need a large context: a few times their first request. 32768 is enough for opencode, 65536 for Claude Code ([sizing the context](docs/server-api.md#sizing-the-context-for-a-client)). ```jsonc // opencode, ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "provider": { "bmoe": { "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible", "options": { "baseURL": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1", "apiKey": "local" }, "models": { "": { "limit": { "context": 32768, "output": 8192 } } } } }, "model": "bmoe/" } ``` ```bash # Claude Code export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=local export ANTHROPIC_MODEL= export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=$ANTHROPIC_MODEL export CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=65536 claude ``` ```toml # Codex CLI, ~/.codex/config.toml model = "" model_provider = "bmoe" [model_providers.bmoe] name = "bmoe" base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1" wire_api = "responses" env_key = "BMOE_API_KEY" # export BMOE_API_KEY=local ``` Under **Connect apps**, the app writes the settings for opencode and Codex CLI and shows the ones for Claude Code. **The agent.** The desktop app has its own agent: it works in a folder you choose, reads and edits files and runs commands, and asks before it changes anything unless you allow it. A conversation can also be run by OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex or Pi. See [docs/agent.md](docs/agent.md). ## How it works For each token, the router of each layer picks a few experts. The engine looks for them in up to three tiers, each a cache for the one below: - **VRAM**, on a graphics card: the weights every token reads, and the experts used most. - **RAM**: a cache of experts. Without a graphics card, also the weights every token reads. - **Flash** (the drive): the whole model. An expert missing from VRAM is copied from RAM; one missing from RAM is read from flash. On a phone or an Apple-silicon Mac the GPU uses the same RAM as the CPU, so there are two tiers. A model that fits the card runs on it whole. Streaming only reads, so it does not wear the drive. The engine uses llama.cpp's public API, so its quantizations, tokenizers and chat templates work unchanged, and an upgrade is a submodule bump. Which tensors are experts is read from the file ([docs/which-models-stream.md](docs/which-models-stream.md)). Design: [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md). ## The planner

The planner reads the model's header and measures the machine: memory, storage speed, each CPU, GPU and NPU. Its rules name no device or platform, so a phone and a desktop get different plans from the same code. Values you set yourself are kept. See [docs/hardware-planning.md](docs/hardware-planning.md).

## Platforms | | Android | macOS | Windows | Linux | iOS | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Engine and CLI | arm64 | Apple silicon | x86_64, arm64 | x86_64, aarch64 | arm64 (in the app) | | App | native app | desktop app | desktop app | desktop app | native app, built from source | | Accelerators | Hexagon NPU, Vulkan, OpenCL | Metal | Vulkan, CUDA, OpenCL (arm64), Hexagon NPU (arm64) | Vulkan, CUDA, HIP | Metal | | Tested on | 12 GB phone | 16 GB laptop | 16 GB laptop | rented 12-24 GB NVIDIA and 192 GB AMD cards | 12 GB iPhone | Details: [docs/platforms.md](docs/platforms.md). ## How it compares | | **BigMoeOnEdge** | Strata | ds4 | colibri | KTransformers | |---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:| | Android phone (NPU too) | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | | iPhone | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | | Mac | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | | Windows / Linux, CPU only | ✅ | ❌ | Linux, for debugging | ✅ | ❌ | | NVIDIA | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | AMD (ROCm) | ✅ (MI300X too) | Radeon RX and Strix Halo | Strix Halo and RDNA | Vulkan | ✅ | | Any MoE model in GGUF | ✅ | few models | few models | its own format | few models | | Configures itself | ✅ `--auto` | picks the model by memory | expert-cache budget | `coli tune` | ❌ | Speeds and sources: [docs/comparison.md](docs/comparison.md). ## Build from source ```bash git clone --recursive https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge.git cd BigMoeOnEdge cd ui && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. scripts/build-host.sh build/bin/bmoe-server --open ``` A llama.cpp backend is a CMake flag passed through: `scripts/build-host.sh -DGGML_VULKAN=ON` (or `-DGGML_CUDA=ON`). Tests: `cd build && ctest --output-on-failure` (needs `python3` with `gguf`). Android: `scripts/build-android.ps1`, then the APK in [examples/android](examples/android). On the phone itself, in Termux: `pkg install git cmake clang make nodejs-lts`, then the steps above with `scripts/build-host.sh -DBMOE_BACKEND_MODULES=OFF`, one CPU library for that phone's cores instead of a module per instruction-set tier. More: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Documentation [docs/](docs/README.md). Start with [hardware-planning.md](docs/hardware-planning.md), [settings.md](docs/settings.md), [server-api.md](docs/server-api.md) and [limitations.md](docs/limitations.md). ## Prior art AirLLM, Apple's *LLM in a flash*, FlexGen, PowerInfer, EdgeMoE and [flash-moe](https://github.com/danveloper/flash-moe), a Metal engine that streams a 397B MoE from SSD on Apple silicon. ## License Apache-2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). The binaries and apps also carry llama.cpp, ggml and other libraries under MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0 and SIL OFL 1.1: [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES).

English · 中文 · 日本語 · Español · Français · Italiano

> 本文为译文；以英文 README 为准，英文版可能更新。 运行比设备内存更大的混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）模型。模型需要专家时，从闪存读取。 支持 Android、iOS、macOS、Windows 和 Linux，基于 llama.cpp 构建。 统一的流式加载框架：从手机、笔记本到消费级和数据中心 GPU，支持任何硬件、任何操作系统、任何模型、任何量化。 自动资源调度，为优化 tok/s 量身定制。
12 GB Android 手机
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · 5-6 tok/s		 12 GB iPhone
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · 6 tok/s
16 GB Apple silicon 笔记本
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B · 18-24 tok/s
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 大于每台设备的内存；任何 GGUF 格式的 MoE 模型、任何量化都可以运行。解码速度取自[性能](#性能)表。 **2021 年的笔记本，没有 GPU 的智能体**：把流行的体素宝塔提示词交给内置智能体，运行在 16 GB 内存、仅用 CPU 的 ThinkPad 上，模型为 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q4_K_M。以 2.3 tok/s 写出 988 行，然后在应用的预览中打开页面；加速的部分已在画面上标出。

## 功能 - **运行装不下的模型。** MoE 模型每个 token 只使用少数几个专家。引擎将每个 token 都需要的权重和最常用的专家保留在内存中，其余从闪存读取。输出与将整个模型放在内存中时相同；测试会对此进行验证。 - **自动配置。** `--auto` 测量机器和模型，选择缓存大小、线程数以及由哪个设备做什么。Plan 界面展示每项选择及其原因。 - **任意 MoE GGUF。** llama.cpp 能加载的都可以，任意量化格式。没有针对单个模型的代码。 - **所有后端。** CPU、Metal、CUDA、HIP、Vulkan、OpenCL 和 Hexagon NPU。在显卡上，最常用的专家保留在 VRAM 中。 - **应用与服务器。** 桌面应用、手机应用，以及面向编程智能体的 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容服务器。 - **识别图像。** 把模型的投影器文件（`mmproj`）放在模型旁边，服务器在每个 API 上都能读取图像；CLI 使用 `--mmproj` 和 `--image`。llama.cpp 投影器库支持的任意视觉模型，任意量化格式，所有后端。 ## 性能 | 硬件 | 内存 | 模型 | 磁盘占用 | 专家读取自 | 解码 tok/s | |---|---|---|---:|---|---:| | **Android 手机** | 12 GB | DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B | 91 GB | 闪存 | 1 | | | | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 80 GB | 闪存 | 2-4 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | 闪存 | 5-6 | | **iPhone** | 12 GB | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | 闪存 | 6 | | **Apple silicon 笔记本** | 16 GB | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 76 GB | 闪存 | 7-9 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | 闪存 | 18-24 | | **Windows 笔记本** | 16 GB | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | 闪存 | 5 | | **桌面 GPU**（NVIDIA） | 12 GB + 128 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 84 GB | RAM，GPU 缓存 | 16-17 | | **桌面 GPU**（NVIDIA） | 16 GB + 32 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | 闪存，GPU 缓存 | 19-21 | | **桌面 GPU**（NVIDIA） | 24 GB + 96 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | RAM，GPU 缓存 | 70 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | GPU | 217 | | **桌面 GPU**（NVIDIA） | 24 GB + 62 GB RAM | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | GPU | 154 | | | 其中 12 GB 空闲 | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | RAM，GPU 缓存 | 59-67 | | | | Gemma 4 26B-A4B | 17 GB | GPU | 114 | | | | Laguna XS 2.1 33B | 20 GB | GPU | 93-94 | | **桌面 GPU**（NVIDIA） | 8 GB + 31 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | 闪存，GPU 缓存 | 16 | | | | Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | 21 GB | RAM，GPU 缓存 | 37-44 | | **两块桌面 GPU**（NVIDIA） | 2 × 16 GB + 60 GB RAM | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | RAM，GPU 缓存 | 41-48 | | | | DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B | 91 GB | 闪存，GPU 缓存 | 5 | | **数据中心 GPU**（AMD，ROCm） | 192 GB | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B | 66 GB | GPU | 53 | 范围表示多次运行之间的差异。方法与每次运行： [docs/benchmarks.md](docs/benchmarks.md)。如需添加你的机器，请运行 `scripts/bench-report.sh model.gguf` 并提交一份 [基准测试报告](https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/issues/new?template=benchmark-report.yml)。 ## 安装 从[最新版本](https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/releases/latest)获取： - **macOS**（Apple 芯片）：打开 `.dmg`，将应用拖到"应用程序"。尚未公证；首次启动所需的一个步骤写在 dmg 的 README.txt 中。 - **Windows**：运行 `-setup.exe`。无需管理员权限。 - **Linux**：为 `.AppImage` 添加可执行权限后运行。窗口需要 WebKitGTK 4.1； `--server` 只运行服务器。 - **Android**：安装 `app-dev-release.apk`。每个版本都会覆盖安装在上一个版本之上。 - **iOS**：使用 Xcode 从 [examples/ios](examples/ios/README.md) 构建。实验性功能。 打开应用，在 **Models** 中选择一个模型。NVIDIA 或 AMD 显卡可从 **Settings** 获取其后端 （[docs/desktop-app.md](docs/desktop-app.md)）。 仅命令行工具（`bmoe-cli`、`bmoe-server`）： ```bash curl -fsSL https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh ``` ```powershell irm https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` ## 使用 ```bash bmoe-cli -m model.gguf --auto -p "Explain MoE routing." # plan and run bmoe-cli -m model.gguf --plan # print the plan bmoe-server -m model.gguf -c 32768 # the server and its web UI, port 8765 ``` 服务器支持 OpenAI API（`/v1/chat/completions`、`/v1/responses`）和 Anthropic API（`/v1/messages`）， 包括流式输出、工具调用和推理。添加 `--host 0.0.0.0 --api-key KEY` 即可为其他机器提供服务。 参考：[docs/server-api.md](docs/server-api.md)。 ```python from openai import OpenAI client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1", api_key="local") reply = client.chat.completions.create(model="local", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]) print(reply.choices[0].message.content) ``` **编程智能体**需要较大的上下文：约为其首个请求的几倍。opencode 用 32768 足够，Claude Code 用 65536 （[为客户端设定上下文大小](docs/server-api.md#sizing-the-context-for-a-client)）。 ```jsonc // opencode, ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "provider": { "bmoe": { "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible", "options": { "baseURL": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1", "apiKey": "local" }, "models": { "": { "limit": { "context": 32768, "output": 8192 } } } } }, "model": "bmoe/" } ``` ```bash # Claude Code export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=local export ANTHROPIC_MODEL= export ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=$ANTHROPIC_MODEL export CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=65536 claude ``` ```toml # Codex CLI, ~/.codex/config.toml model = "" model_provider = "bmoe" [model_providers.bmoe] name = "bmoe" base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1" wire_api = "responses" env_key = "BMOE_API_KEY" # export BMOE_API_KEY=local ``` 在 **Connect apps** 中，应用会写入 opencode 和 Codex CLI 的设置，并显示 Claude Code 所需的设置。 **智能体。** 桌面应用有自己的智能体：它在你选择的文件夹中工作，读取和编辑文件、运行命令；除非你允许，否则在做任何更改前都会先询问。 对话也可以交给 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex 或 Pi 运行。参见 [docs/agent.md](docs/agent.md)。 ## 工作原理 对每个 token，每一层的路由器选出几个专家。引擎最多在三个层级中查找它们，每一层都是下一层的缓存： - **VRAM**（在显卡上）：每个 token 都要读取的权重，以及最常用的专家。 - **RAM**：专家缓存。没有显卡时，也保存每个 token 都要读取的权重。 - **闪存**（硬盘）：整个模型。 VRAM 缺少的专家从 RAM 复制；RAM 缺少的专家从闪存读取。在手机或 Apple silicon Mac 上，GPU 与 CPU 使用同一块 RAM，因此只有两个层级。能装进显卡的模型会完整地在显卡上运行。 流式读取只读不写，因此不会磨损硬盘。 引擎使用 llama.cpp 的公开 API，因此其量化格式、分词器和对话模板都可直接使用，升级只需更新子模块。 哪些张量是专家从文件中读取（[docs/which-models-stream.md](docs/which-models-stream.md)）。设计： [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)。 ## 规划器

规划器读取模型的文件头并测量机器：内存、存储速度、每个 CPU、GPU 和 NPU。其规则不指定任何设备或平台， 因此同一份代码会为手机和台式机给出不同的方案。你自己设定的值会被保留。参见 [docs/hardware-planning.md](docs/hardware-planning.md)。

从源码构建 ```bash git clone --recursive https://github.com/Helldez/BigMoeOnEdge.git cd BigMoeOnEdge cd ui && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. scripts/build-host.sh build/bin/bmoe-server --open ``` llama.cpp 后端只需原样传入一个 CMake 选项：`scripts/build-host.sh -DGGML_VULKAN=ON` （或 `-DGGML_CUDA=ON`）。测试：`cd build && ctest --output-on-failure`（需要安装了 `gguf` 的 `python3`）。Android： `scripts/build-android.ps1`，然后在 [examples/android](examples/android) 中构建 APK。更多： [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ##
